versions.changelog:
No changes detected in this release.

- Version number updated to 1.0.1, but all files remain unchanged.

Initial release of Mac Mini AI — local AI server and fleet for Mac Mini:

- Enables running LLMs, image generation, speech-to-text, and embeddings locally on Mac Mini (M4 and M4 Pro).
- Supports easy stacking of multiple Mac Minis into a managed AI fleet, with automatic device discovery and request routing.
- Provides simple setup, OpenAI-compatible API, and works without Docker or Kubernetes.
- Includes dashboard, monitoring, and model recommendations per device.
- Built-in guardrails: explicit user confirmation for model downloads and deletions; all requests processed locally.
